notes: Build Forge 0.2.0 introduces project blueprints, curated rule packs, integrity-verified updates, and opt-in local branch workflows. Branch workflows are opt-in via git.workflow in project-profile.yaml; no action is required for existing projects. Vetting scan output now separates findings into HIGH, MEDIUM, and LOW severities with reduced prose noise.

actions.title: Preview and run project profile migration
Audit code hazards and adopt curated rule packs
Move deprecated external_references from profile to references.yaml
Upgrade unstamped generated convention skills to stamped template
Pass --write to legacy import if tooling expects legacy-parity.md
Run update to add .agents/.gitignore and stop caches from being committed

notes: Build Forge 0.3.0 adds the optional project-readme skill. It writes a README in 1 of 4 styles and keeps the GitHub description, homepage, and topics in .agents/repo-meta.yaml. No action is required for existing projects.
